title: Match
description:
Welcome to Match, where your characters become someone to discover. Browse a deck of generated profiles, read their vibe, and swipe to find the ones you click with.

Features:
- Swipe through your characters: Like or pass on a fresh deck of profiles drawn from your characters, each with their own name, photo, and personality.
- Read their taste: See a short bio and personality tags that capture who they are before you decide.
- Summon new matches: Keep swiping and the app keeps generating more characters to meet.
- Peek behind the scenes: Reveal the generated prompt behind any profile to see how each character came to life.
